evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, main() wraps run(argv) in try/except Exception and calls write_result({'error': ...}) before returning 1. Thus a ValueError from select_job() in the explicit-selector branch at line 1624 no longer bypasses JSON emission; the traceback is narrated to stderr and stdout still gets one error artifact. This was fixed by b378265d5b33dfbc00310f384e8c4f90d9faaf56 (with later traceback retention in 59473742d1d2810890da73a48b5abed9bd41f2b2).
